monster.ddr_elite.desc: An elite Daydream Chems operator — squad lead and field tester of proprietary reagents. This kind of commander sets the pace, runs the defensive sector, and “sterilizes” rooms with in-house munitions.
monster.ddr_elite.name: Neutralizer
monster.desperado_Grasshopper_female.des: Sometimes fresh media exec proposes to replace Desperado main character in their bestseller flick with specops of their corporation. Such idea is yet to pass the screenings.
monster.desperado_Grasshopper_male.desc: Sometimes fresh media exec proposes to replace Desperado main character in their bestseller flick with specops of their corporation. Such idea is yet to pass the screenings.
monster.desperado_Grasshopper_male.name: Desperado
monster.dil_cyborg_battle_Dilthey.desc: A miracle of Dilthey engineering. Named for Augusta Ada King, née Byron — Sergei King’s favorite female mathematician.
monster.dil_cyborg_battle_Dilthey.name: A.D.A.
monster.dil_elite_female.desc: A combat unit and the pinnacle of engineering genius of the Dilthey Corporation.
monster.dil_elite_female.name: Nexus
monster.dil_elite_male.desc: A combat unit and the pinnacle of engineering genius of the Dilthey Corporation.
monster.dil_elite_male.name: Nexus
monster.drone_cargo.desc: Pocket-loader built for crate transportation. It frequently drops it on the feet of humans and clones.
monster.drone_cargo.name: Cargo Drone
monster.drone_security.desc: Autonomous airborne guard. It greets trespassers with alert and lead shots.
monster.drone_security.name: Security Drone
monster.edward_lowrance_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You look at yourself from the outside and, for the first time, wonder whether you ever had naturally born prototypes at all. Why shouldn’t clones simply be engineered corporate products? You should remember to leave a positive review for being given the face of such a handsome man.

monster.elite_female.desc: An elite warrior with the best training and equipment her employer was willing to spend on.
monster.elite_female.name: Stormtrooper
monster.elite_male.desc: An elite warrior with the best training and equipment his employer was willing to spend on.
monster.elite_male.name: Stormtrooper
monster.enforcer_CoreWard_female.desc: Mines are rough place filled with even rougher people. Overseer keeps them in line.
monster.enforcer_CoreWard_female.name: Overseer
monster.enforcer_CoreWard_male.desc: Mines are rough place filled with even rougher people. Overseer keeps them in line.
monster.enforcer_CoreWard_male.name: Overseer
monster.enforcer_DaydreamChems_female.de: Heavily armed Daydream Chems combatant. Their slogan: “Everything ahead of us is fleeing, behind us everything is burning”.
monster.enforcer_DaydreamChems_male.desc: Heavily armed Daydream Chems combatant. Their slogan: “Everything ahead of us is fleeing, behind us everything is burning”.
monster.enforcer_DaydreamChems_male.name: Desolator
monster.enforcer_female.desc: A heavily armored fighter that excels in both attack and defense.
monster.enforcer_female.name: Enforcer
monster.enforcer_male.desc: A heavily armored fighter that excels in both attack and defense.
monster.enforcer_male.name: Enforcer
monster.enforcer_PlanetBridge_female.des: While Planetbridge prefers to deal with boarders before they land, Marines are ready to give any intruder proper welcome.
monster.enforcer_PlanetBridge_male.desc: While Planetbridge prefers to deal with boarders before they land, Marines are ready to give any intruder proper welcome.
monster.enforcer_PlanetBridge_male.name: Marine
monster.flauros_baron.desc: One of the High Thanes of Flauros, a horned god of the void. He is girded in the skulls of the greatest warriors of his own clan, and with every foe he fells, his antlers grow harder — and stronger.
monster.flauros_baron.name: Ard Rí
monster.flauros_knight.desc: A centaur-knight of Flauros. No eyes dwell in the hollows of a Curidh’s skull — only the clan’s call guides him, ever toward battle. Servants of the Red and Gold Throne, they are doomed never to see it.
monster.flauros_knight.name: Curidh
monster.flauros_pact_baron.desc: One of the High Thanes of Flauros, a horned god of the void. He is girded in the skulls of the greatest warriors of his own clan, and with every foe he fells, his antlers grow harder — and stronger.
monster.flauros_pact_baron.name: Ard Rí
monster.flauros_pact_falcon.desc: The mournful cry of this quasimorph, charged with the eternal silence of the Outer System, can strip flesh from bone.
monster.flauros_pact_falcon.name: Warcrow Keener
monster.flauros_pact_guardian.desc: A quasimorph charged with guarding Flauros’s right to honor the pacts bestowed upon the barons by their bramfatura.
monster.flauros_pact_guardian.name: Living Warden of the Ways
monster.flauros_pact_turret.desc: A quasimorph flower that phases in from Flauros under complex, hard-to-reproduce conditions.
monster.flauros_pact_turret.name: Morrigania sporifera
monster.flauros_pact_werewolf.desc: Now you look so worn, so thin, you're a taker, devils-maker, let me hear you sing. You don't smile anymore, you're a drifter, shapeshifter, let me see you run.
monster.flauros_pact_werewolf.name: Shapeshifter
monster.flauros_pact_zombie_female.desc: An emptied human body set in motion by quasimorphic spores spread by the primordial forests of Flauros.
monster.flauros_pact_zombie_female.name: Boneblight Wight
monster.flauros_pact_zombie_male.desc: An emptied human body set in motion by quasimorphic spores spread by the primordial forests of Flauros.
monster.flauros_pact_zombie_male.name: Boneblight Wight
monster.flauros_servitor.desc: Gilles are the submissive servants of Flauros. Their antlers are not their own, but trophies torn from the skulls of less fortunate Gilles. Each of them bears the brand of an ancient clan, yet knows not its name — for they are unworthy to remember.
monster.flauros_servitor.name: Gille
monster.fra_ceo_male.desc: He calls himself a "security architect". Believes freedom means knowing your place — especially if that place is 2x3 meters and windowless.
monster.fra_ceo_male.name: Lucien Rochefort
monster.fra_elite_female.desc: Franche-Comte PS elite wardens that trained for maximum security prisons and convoys of high-risk prisoners.
monster.fra_elite_female.name: Carceral security
monster.fra_elite_male.desc: Franche-Comte PS elite wardens that trained for maximum security prisons and convoys of high-risk prisoners.
monster.fra_elite_male.name: Carceral security
monster.francis_reid_daly_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You know that Jane says only good things about you behind your back. You look at this face and understand that a handsome bastard like that is impossible not to love.
monster.francis_reid_daly.desc: Your own shadow. You know that Jane says only good things about you behind your back. You look at this face and understand that a handsome bastard like that is impossible not to love.
monster.francis_reid_daly.name: Shrike
monster.giant_DaydreamChems.desc: Test Subjects who got lucky in the genetic lottery envy those who were not.
monster.giant_DaydreamChems.name: Experiment
monster.gra_ceo_male.desc: Built an business empire on the premise that if nobody’s shooting at your shipment, it probably isn’t worth shipping.
monster.gra_ceo_male.name: Hodaya Lehmann
monster.gra_elite_female.desc: Grasshopper Tek elite. Space truckers and the Guardsmen of high-value cargo protection.
monster.gra_elite_female.name: Convoy Service
monster.gra_elite_male.desc: Grasshopper Tek elite. Space truckers and the Guardsmen of high-value cargo protection.
monster.gra_elite_male.name: Convoy Service

monster.grenadier_RealWare_female.name: Combat engineer

monster.grenadier_RealWare_male.name: Combat engineer
monster.hannah_reich_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You look straight at Hanna Reich, and you feel slightly uneasy. They made a woman into a tool, and she decided there was nothing better left than to become the most efficient tool they had.
monster.hannah_reich.desc: Your own shadow. You look straight at Hanna Reich, and you feel slightly uneasy. They made a woman into a tool, and she decided there was nothing better left than to become the most efficient tool they had.
monster.hannah_reich.name: Domino
monster.Isabella_capet_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You see the She-Wolf in the flesh. A rare case where you can appreciate how every chiseled line of that noble face reflects combat efficiency.
monster.Isabella_capet.desc: Your own shadow. You see the She-Wolf in the flesh. A rare case where you can appreciate how every chiseled line of that noble face reflects combat efficiency.

monster.jacques_kennet_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You see a clone whose engineers once listened to the whining of frontline operator-ability testers and decided that a fighter whose abilities revolve around shooting should help with... shooting.
monster.jacques_kennet.desc: Your own shadow. You see a clone whose engineers once listened to the whining of frontline operator-ability testers and decided that a fighter whose abilities revolve around shooting should help with... shooting.
monster.jacques_kennet.name: Cowboy
monster.jan_shrammert_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You see a slightly tired man, but one still ready for battle. Lean and wiry, he can force his body into unbelievable flexibility, staying unseen without losing any of his lethality.
monster.jan_shrammert.desc: Your own shadow. You see a slightly tired man, but one still ready for battle. Lean and wiry, he can force his body into unbelievable flexibility, staying unseen without losing any of his lethality.

monster.jungle_spider.name: Spider
monster.kenzie_yukio_custom.desc: Your own shadow. There is no bloodlust in Kunai’s eyes, but you can see that the art of iaijutsu, grafted into levels far deeper than consciousness, has turned his body itself into a weapon thirsting for blood.

monster.marika_wulfnod.desc: Your own shadow. Before you stands Marika Wolfnod, one of the most beautiful women in this dangerous business. It is a little bitter and insulting to know that all those men will still choose talkative Jane over an efficient Nymph.

monster.mars_baron.desc: Barakunarashi are quasimorphs that drag unfortunate victims into the deep layers of the bramfatura of Mars. Aristocrats of Ur were one of million of the offspring of Urparp. Now they all are disinherited and fight for the attention of resurrected Tyrant.
monster.mars_baron.name: Barakunarash
monster.mars_battle_flame.desc: A shrill in the depths, a chant of a fleshy mass, and suddenly you're face to face with a horrifying being of ash and red sand. Armored mask stares at you with a perpetual tension, and another shrill explodes from its tapered mouth in a show of force. Welcome to the Ur the Restored and its guardians greet you.
monster.mars_battle_flame.name: Esangilian
monster.mars_battle_gun.desc: Barzapkhu is no creature — it is a rite of war clad in iron. From within its smoking barrels cry the souls of Mars’ unborn.
monster.mars_battle_gun.name: Barzapkhu
monster.mars_crab.desc: Libator or "hellcrab" is the royal gavvakh collector and the royal fleshfinder. Libators are known as dull and vicious servants of Tyrant among other eannis (quasimorphs of Ur the Restored).
monster.mars_crab.name: Libator
monster.mars_knight.desc: An emissary of Ur, tasked with executing the commissions of Mars’s bramfatura—meant to steer the Solar System toward Gagtungr’s new reign.
monster.mars_knight.name: Anunnaku
monster.mars_pact_baron.desc: Barakunarashi are quasimorphs that drag unfortunate victims into the deep layers of the bramfatura of Mars. Aristocrats of Ur were one of million of the offspring of Urparp. Now they all are disinherited and fight for the attention of resurrected Tyrant.
monster.mars_pact_baron.name: Barakunarash
monster.mars_pact_golem.desc: A cybernetic golem of Ur the Restored, assembled to mock humanity. The forge-furnace in its belly is always ready to spew punishing flame.
monster.mars_pact_golem.name: Frameforged
monster.mars_pact_turret.desc: A quasimorphic firepoint, a war idol of Ur the Restored, made not for attack or defense, but for the dearly desired chaos on the battlefield.
monster.mars_pact_turret.name: Ninurta Crownfire
monster.mars_support.desc: Gallu is quasimorph of Ur the Restored that serve to defend the bramfatura of Mars at any cost. They look like enormous-size insects but inside many asymmetrical eyes there is the glow of hatred and strange intelligence.
monster.mars_support.name: Gallu
monster.maximilian_rohr_custom.desc: Your own shadow. You see Max Rohr. And he looks exactly the way a clone should look when he can survive where others would have died long ago.
monster.maximilian_rohr.desc: Your own shadow. You see Max Rohr. And he looks exactly the way a clone should look when he can survive where others would have died long ago.
monster.maximilian_rohr.name: Max
monster.medic_AnCom_female.desc: AnCom doctors are considered the most competent in the Inner System. Nobody knows why AnCom is so strict when selecting medical personnel. On most stations of the System there are doctors capable of providing first aid or caring for the sick and wounded.
monster.medic_AnCom_female.name: Magus

monster.medic_combat_Dilthey_female.name: Bioengineer

monster.merc_angels_of_spades_female.des: The Angels of Spades pipeline produces what the System calls a “staff sniper.” The black market calls them the “Lee Harvey Brigade.”
monster.merc_cobra_male.desc: The Contract Brigade for Repossession of Assets pipeline is tuned for one thing: minimal harm to the asset, maximum harm to the personnel guarding it.
monster.merc_cobra_male.name: Co.B.R.A.
monster.merc_doppelganger_pack_female.de: No one knows what conditions birthed the Terror Pack training package. Their operators run well past the guardrails — far beyond any “safe settings.”
monster.merc_eclipse_blades_female.desc: The Eclipse Blades program is built for taking station chokepoints. First the lights and comms die. Then the door pops. Then the contract becomes enforceable.
monster.merc_eclipse_blades_female.name: Eclipse Blade
monster.merc_golem_group_female.desc: A Golem Group operator can throw up an automated fire line fast, keeping hands-on work for absolute last resort.
monster.merc_golem_group_female.name: Golem
monster.merc_martian_mech_male.desc: Martian Mech Inf training is built on an outdated framework from one of RealWare’s security services. These operators hate the constraints and weakness of their own flesh, and they keep trying to outgrow it.
monster.merc_martian_mech_male.name: Martian Mechmarine
monster.merc_phantom_female.desc: A translucent astral body capable of dealing physical damage. Despite its ghostly nature, the copy's strike is tangible and destructive.
monster.merc_phantom_female.name: Astral copy
monster.merc_phantom_male.desc: A translucent astral body capable of dealing physical damage. Despite its ghostly nature, the copy's strike is tangible and destructive.
monster.merc_phantom_male.name: Astral copy
monster.merc_phoenix_brigade_male.desc: A Phoenix Brigade operator is tech-literate and can field-assemble robots in the dirt. They don’t “win” fights. They scale production until resistance stops making financial sense.
monster.merc_phoenix_brigade_male.name: Phoenix
monster.merc_scouts_of_hades_male.desc: A contractor put through the Scouts of Hades pipeline. False trails, mapping stations’ soft spots, selling infiltration routes and services to both sides of the same shooting war. To them, people are just mobile assets with opinions.
monster.merc_scouts_of_hades_male.name: Scout of Hades
monster.merc_spaceborn_ghosts_male.desc: An infiltrator trained under the Spaceborn Ghosts schema prefers to work far from their own base. The contract goes to the one who’s already in the area, already close to the asset.
